title: Check Whether Two Binary Trees are Identical
problemStatement: Given the roots of two binary trees, determine whether both trees are structurally identical and contain the same values at corresponding nodes.
input: • The first line contains N₁. • The next N₁ lines describe the first tree. • The following line contains N₂. • The next N₂ lines describe the second tree.
output: • Print YES if the trees are identical; otherwise print NO.
